lines.text: Ah! There you are!
Welcome to Astravale, the finest little town in the kingdom!
Well...
It's the finest town for monster hunting, anyway.

If you're looking for a place to raise a family, I'd recommend somewhere else.
Preferably somewhere without monsters.
Astravale was build around one simple idea:

If something has claws, fangs, horns, tentacles, or an unreasonable hatred for
furniture...
Someone here will probably try to kill it.
That's right!
We're an adventurer's town.
Monster hunters, treasure seekers, wandering swordsmen, spellcasters...

And the occasional person who picked up a sword and decided that was enough
training.
Those ones usually don't stay long.
That beautiful wooden board over there, you say?
Ah, yes! That's the Bounty Board!
Every paper pinned to it is a monster causing trouble somewhere int the world.
And every bounty on that board comes with a little something called...
MONEY.
You see, adventuring is a noble profession.
Very noble, very heroic and very...
Profitable.
That's why people come here from all over.
Some arrive alone, some bring friends.

Some arrive in groups of four and immediately start arguing about who gets
to be the swordsman.
Personally, I recommend having a mage.
A good mage can turn a terrifying monster into a pile of ash.
A bad mage can turn your friends into a pile of ash.
Either way...something gets burned.
Now, don't worry if you're alone. Astravle has plenty of work for a lone adventurer.
And if you've brought companions? Even better!
Now..
Before you rush off to slay dragons and become a legendary hero...or something.
There's a little problem we like to give newcomers.
A sort of...
ENTRANCE EXAM
Don't worry. It's nothing complicated.
You just need to defeat a monster.
A very small, harmless and...
Well...
GREEN monster.
And it lives at the bottom of the well.
It's very simple actually.
Go down the well
Find the slime and...
Hit it until it stops moving.
SIMPLE!
Once you've defeated it, come back here. I'll reward you.
HOW? You asked?
With a little something called EXPERIENCE, of course.
Now then! Grab a weapon. Gather your friends and most of all...
TRY NOT TO DIE!
After all...
Astravale didn't become famous because its adventurers were smart.
It became famous because they kept coming back.
Welcome to ASTRAVALE, adventurer!
